slug: 2026-03-02 Botswana - Minister envisions reforms to boost service delivery (digital Omang)

facts.fact: The 2026/27 budget allocates P105 million to production of Omang national identity cards, which the ministry says it is issuing.
P42 million of the development budget goes to computerisation projects including the Biometric Omang system, alongside a wider Digital ID project.

systems.owner: Ministry of Labour and Home Affairs
